id: title:darkopia:size webhook only batch audiences against the flat limit

review.posthog_relevance: Adds workflow email execution support and tiered email caps, potentially helping users avoid unexpected costs or enforce tier limits.
review.reason: Adds WorkflowAction type and workflowSendsEmail helper; fetchWorkflow now returns sendsEmail; sizeAudience accepts sendsEmail and passes it to backend; workflow execution handlers extract sendsEmail and pass it downstream.
review.uncertainty: The implementation and relevant checks are visible, but the actual tiered email caps and backend enforcement are not demonstrated in this chunk; the benefit relies on unverified backend compatibility and tier configuration.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed.

observations.behavior: Adds WorkflowAction type and workflowSendsEmail helper; fetchWorkflow now returns sendsEmail; sizeAudience accepts sendsEmail and passes it to backend; workflow execution handlers extract sendsEmail and pass it downstream.
observations.posthog_connection: The MCP workflow batch handlers now include the email-step flag when requesting blast radius, allowing the backend to apply tiered email caps. This could help PostHog users avoid unexpected costs or enforce email tier limits when workflows include email actions.
